verdict.rationale: Grok's own overview describes Grok Bot as a way to 'hand real work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer', which is a first-party claim of delegated, persistent background work. Multi-agent research shows multi-step orchestration, but it runs in real time rather than in the background. The evidence is one thin line, with no detail on how tasks run autonomously or how results come back for review. Missing for 10: documented background or async task execution and lifecycle, a review or hand-back workflow for results, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Grok Bot.
